customrecordtype.description: Sprint 2 U5 (HIGH-13) — operational retry queue for Twilio calls whose Phone Call record creation failed inside the RESTlet logCall handler. The rep is waiting on a synchronous response so the RESTlet cannot retry inline; it persists a lightweight orphan row with the call metadata and the scheduled poller retries the Phone Call create on its next cycle. Rows are deleted on successful retry. Rows that hit retryCount=3 remain for admin triage. Hidden from admin UI via allowuiaccess=F.

customrecordcustomfield.label: Twilio Call SID
customrecordcustomfield.description: The Twilio CallSid that triggered the orphan. Indexed for deduplication — the scheduled poller skips orphans whose callSid already corresponds to a saved Phone Call.

customrecordcustomfield.label: Recording SID (if known)
customrecordcustomfield.description: The Twilio RecordingSid if the recording-started webhook had already delivered it. May be empty for early orphans.

customrecordcustomfield.label: Entity (Customer/Lead/Contact)
customrecordcustomfield.description: The CRM entity the call belongs to. Used to re-attempt the Phone Call create with the correct parent link.

customrecordcustomfield.label: Entity Type
customrecordcustomfield.description: customer | contact | lead | prospect — disambiguates the entityId across record types.

customrecordcustomfield.label: Calling User
customrecordcustomfield.description: Employee who placed the call. Carried so the retry pass can set the assigned field on the recreated Phone Call.

customrecordcustomfield.label: Phone Number
customrecordcustomfield.description: The phone number dialled. Carried so the retry pass can recreate the Phone Call title.

customrecordcustomfield.label: Direction
customrecordcustomfield.description: outbound | inbound. CTC is outbound-only today, but the field is carried for future inbound support.

customrecordcustomfield.label: Retry Count
customrecordcustomfield.description: Incremented each time the scheduled poller retries the Phone Call create and the save still fails. Capped at 3 — rows that hit the cap remain for admin triage and log.error fires on every cycle.
